runtime_note: Full reproduction recomputes610 weighted-support/parity models and may take roughly30–60CPU seconds.
logic: Quadruples meeting a,b in zero or two points are invariant. Triple supports from both-containing rows cover both targets. Empty/singleton exclusive supports cost2/1. Remaining supports have their multiplicity as a weighted NAE cost. Only two-variable constraints whose weight exceeds the remaining target budget are made mandatory; their parity components are contracted and forced costs recomputed until contradiction. Conditional forced costs above7 are not unconditional neighborhood optima.
scope: Complete exclusion of<=6 holes in this paired-point neighborhood on this exact parent only; not a global covering-design lower bound.
hardening: v2 replaces verification asserts with explicit exceptions and a side-effecting parity join inside assert with an unconditional join plus check. Normal Python algorithm is unchanged; Python -O no longer disables validation or merges. Original all1431 proof used normal Python.
